items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Stevie and Michael are running it for her... [INTERVIEWER] Stevie and Michael are her sons?

ctx.x: But I called up AGAC, and when that check doesn't come here, I call AGAC, and I tell them and they call New York, and the man told AGAC, he said, "She's late as usual." They are always late, and when Duke Ellington was living, Juan used to call Duke, and would say, "Duke, where is my check?" He, in turn, would call Ruth and we would get the money. But now that Duke's gone ... and all publishers know that she is a terrible payer.
Well, I think it's kind of disorganized at Tempo. She said that Stevie and Michael are running it for her, but I don't know.
